name: Mochida Yuka
source:
Age: 14 (at death)

Satoshi's younger sister who died after being abandoned by him and then killed by the Girl in Red. Having been trapped in the school for six years, she has grown to hate the living and find Ayumi as a promising scapegoat to take out her anger on. She calls Sachiko "meanie in the red".

[From [url=http://corpse-party-fanon.wikia.com/wiki/Yuka_Mochida_(CPD2)]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
